display.purpose: Page titles (H1): Archivo at 112.5% width, 800, uppercase.

body.purpose: Descriptions and blurbs, at most 60 characters a line.

data.purpose: Every measurement and price: Martian Mono at 87.5% width with tabular numbers.

motion.name: ease-warmth
motion.purpose: The kit figure's 360ms warmth cross-fade, the one eased moment.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: The cart drawer slides in; the scrim fades over 180ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ember action per view: Add to cart, Add kit to cart, Checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ember, #cf3a1c); color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ember-hover, #b0301a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ember, #cf3a1c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined alternative: Shop layers, Retry, Add all three.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink, #111418); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #111418); font: 600 16px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #111418); color: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ember, #cf3a1c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Layer filters and kit choices; the pressed state fills ink.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-line, #cfd5da); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); color: var(--color-ink, #111418); font: 600 14px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-ink, #111418); border-color: var(--color-ink, #111418); color: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ember, #cf3a1c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Size Pills
components.description: Mono size picker; sold out is dashed, ghosted and struck through.
components.css: .ds-sizes { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-size { min-width: 52px; height: 44px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-line, #cfd5da); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); color: var(--color-ink, #111418); font: 400 13px/1 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-size[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-ink, #111418); border-color: var(--color-ink, #111418); color: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); } .ds-size[aria-disabled='true'] { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--color-ghost-line, #b7bec5); color: var(--color-ghost, #8a929a); text-decoration: line-through; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-size:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ember, #cf3a1c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Photo / Thermal Switch
components.description: Two pressed-state buttons in a mist track.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-mist, #dde2e6); } .ds-seg button { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #111418); font: 600 14px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-ink, #111418); color: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ember, #cf3a1c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Range Bar
components.description: A piece's range on the -10 to 80°F axis, always with the range as text.
components.html: Scarp Shell-10 to 60°F
components.css: .ds-range { width: 280px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 400 13px/1.3 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #111418); } .ds-range-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-mono { font: 400 11px/1.3 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--color-ink-2, #4a525b); } .ds-track { position: relative; height: 6px; background: var(--color-mist, #dde2e6); } .ds-fill { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 77.8%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #140c2e, #e88a2c); }

components.name: Store Down Panel
components.description: The square snow panel used for states such as a store outage.
components.html:
The store isn't responding right now.

Try again in a minute. Pages you have already opened keep working.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 32px; background: var(--color-snow, #f8f9fa); color: var(--color-ink, #111418); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 800 24px/1.1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 112.5%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; font: 400 16px/1.55 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-2, #4a525b); }

narrative.overview:
Scaur shows what a layer does, not only what it looks like. The store is light, photo-led and flat: a cool grey ground, near-black type, square photographs cropped hard on the garment, and one warm accent for the things you press. The only rich colour in the interface is the thermal scale, and it appears only where it encodes warmth: range bars, ratings, the thermal photo views and the kit figure.

Everything hangs off one temperature axis, -10°F to 80°F. A product's range bar on a shop tile, its rating on the product page, the home page's layer chart and the kit builder's "comfortable down to" readout all sit on that same axis, so a shopper can compare any two pieces at a glance. Density is moderate: generous section spacing, compact controls, data set in a narrow mono face.

The system refuses the default outdoor-store look: a full-bleed ridge photo with "Shop now", a four-up grid of look-alike jackets, dark neon, glass, blur and drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One temperature axis for every rating, bar and readout.
Thermal colour is data, never decoration.
Flat depth: flat colour fields and 1px rules, no shadows.
Everything you press is a pill; everything you look at is square.
State changes cut; only the kit figure's warmth eases.

rules.name: The Thermal Is Data Rule
rules.body: The heat colours appear only where they encode a temperature. If removing the colour would lose no information, it doesn't belong there.

rules.name: The Quiet Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember marks what you can press next (the primary button, focus, the cart count). It is never a background, a heading colour or a decoration.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: If it is a measurement or money, it is set in Martian Mono. Mono is never used for decoration or labels.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone: no small uppercase kicker above them.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces overlap in flat colour. No box-shadow, blur, glass or gradient anywhere outside the thermal scale.

rules.name: The Pill-Or-Square Rule
rules.body: Everything you press is a full pill: buttons, chips, size pills, colour swatches, the Photo/Thermal switch and the quantity stepper. Everything you look at is square: photos, panels, the drawer, skeletons and range bars. There is no intermediate radius.

dos: Do put every temperature on the shared -10°F to 80°F axis, and print the number next to every bar.
Do set prices, temperatures, sizes and stock in Martian Mono with tabular numbers.
Do keep pressable things full pills and everything else square.
Do cut between states (colourway, Photo to Thermal, kit swaps); ease only the kit figure's warmth (360ms, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`).
Do caption photos below the image, never on it.
Do label illustrative thermal views as illustrative.
donts: Don't use heat colours, gradients or ember for decoration.
Don't add shadows, blur, glass or rounded cards.
Don't use ember for body-size text (4.3:1 on frost).
Don't put text over photographs or use a full-bleed hero with "Shop now".
Don't add scroll-triggered entrances, parallax or marquees; honour reduced motion.
